notes.title: Fan Translations Are Now Possible!
notes.content:
Due to the tremendous request through our community, UNOFFICIAL fan translations are now possible.

As of update 1.0.6 it is now possible for our players to add unofficial translations to the game.

You can now find a file containing all text of the game at the path e.g.

C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\The Detail\The Detail_Data\StreamingAssets\Languages\English.csv

Steps to making a translation for the game are as follows:
1. Make a copy of English.csv
2. Rename the copy to "Override.csv"
3. Translate all the text inside to another languange

More instructions can be found in the file "Adding Translations To The Detail.pdf" which can be found in the same directory.

BY USING OR CREATING TRANSLATIONS YOU ACCEPT THE TRANSLATION EULA.
EULA can be found in the same folder as the instructions and language files.

The update 1.0.6 also includes some general bug fixes.

notes.title: The Detail Holiday Update
notes.content:
With the holidays just around the corner, we thought it only right to offer our fans a bit of extra in the form of [i]The Detail[/i] artbook and OST. Have a good one now, and don't forget to check back for Episode 2: [i]From the Ashes[/i] next year.

Please note – [i]The Detail[/i] Episode 1: Artbook  and Official Soundtrack will be placed in your THE DETAIL folder in the Steam Directory: ...Steam\steamapps\common\The Detail\

We also haven't forgotten to make Episode 1: [i]Where the Dead Lie[/i] even better than before. Here's the latest update, version 1.0.4:

*Gamepad user interface overhauled
*Performance improvements
*Fixed some sounds failing to play under certain conditions
*Fixed logic issues when resuming loaded game for certain scenes
*Quick area transition on double click now works more smoothly
*Fixed glitchy audio transitions in several places
*Fixed some settings menu items displaying current state incorrectly
*Fixed incorrectly aligned speech bubbles
*Fixed bug with hotspot indicators not opening in "Arrival" scene
*Dozens of other bug fixes and other improvements
